record.question: Under F.R. 22, the option for fixation of pay from the date of promotion or from the date of next increment is not available in which of the following cases?
options: Regular promotion to a higher post involving greater duties and responsibilities.
Regular appointment to a new post not involving greater duties and responsibilities.
Appointment on deputation to an ex-cadre post, or appointment on ad hoc basis or direct recruitment basis.
Promotion followed by regular appointment without break.
